note: Circular large-aspect-ratio benchmark (synthetic equilibrium). Per pitch k: drift frequency per unit energy g_k and pitch weight W_k; exact = sum_k W_k int_0^inf x^2.5 e^-x (F1+(x-2.5)F2) nu/((n(omega_E+x g_k))^2+nu^2) dx, nu = nu0 x^-1.5, evaluated with a tan substitution across each pole and adaptive quadrature elsewhere (two independent pole quadratures agree to 1e-6).
